bio.text: Brad Finstad represents Minnesota's 1st District in the U.S. House of Representatives, having been elected in a special election on August 9, 2022.
He is a fourth-generation farmer who lives in the New Ulm area and holds a degree in Agriculture Education from the University of Minnesota.
He previously served as State Director for USDA Rural Development in Minnesota and served three terms in the Minnesota Legislature.
